@pytest.mark.django_db
@freeze_time("2023-01-19 07:00:00")
def test_run_scheduled_event_export_dispatches_due_and_advances(event, user, django_capture_on_commit_callbacks):
    tz = ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")
    due = ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event, owner=user, locale="en", export_identifier="orders", export_form_data={},
        mail_subject="Export", mail_template="Here it is",
        schedule_rrule="DTSTART:20230101T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY",
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30),
        schedule_next_run=datetime(2023, 1, 19, 6, 30, tzinfo=tz),
    )
    not_due = ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event, owner=user, locale="en", export_identifier="orders", export_form_data={},
        mail_subject="Export", mail_template="Here it is",
        schedule_rrule="DTSTART:20230101T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY",
        schedule_rrule_time=time(9, 0),
        schedule_next_run=datetime(2023, 1, 19, 9, 0, tzinfo=tz),
    )
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, "apply_async") as apply_async, \
            django_capture_on_commit_callbacks(execute=True):
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={"event": event.pk, "schedule": due.pk})
    due.refresh_from_db()
    assert due.schedule_next_run == datetime(2023, 1, 20, 6, 30, tzinfo=tz)
    not_due.refresh_from_db()
    assert not_due.schedule_next_run == datetime(2023, 1, 19, 9, 0, tzinfo=tz)
